senses.d: to succeed in doing or completing something successfully
senses.e: She managed to accomplish all her goals before the end of the year.
senses.p: انجام دادن و به اتمام رساندن چیزی با موفقیت
senses.ep: او توانست قبل از پایان سال به تمام اهدافش جامه عمل بپوشاند.

senses.d: correct, exact, and without any mistakes
senses.e: We need to get more accurate information before we make a decision.
senses.ep: ما پیش از گرفتن تصمیم باید اطلاعات دقیق‌تری به دست آوریم.

senses.d: to accept, admit, or recognize that something is true or exists
senses.e: The government finally acknowledged the need for urgent reform.
senses.p: پذیرفتن، اعتراف کردن یا اذعان به چیزی
senses.ep: دولت سرانجام نیاز به اصلاحات فوری را پذیرافت.

senses.d: to obtain or buy something for yourself, or to gain a skill or quality
senses.e: She managed to acquire a good knowledge of Spanish during her travels.
senses.p: به دست آوردن، کسب کردن (مهارت، دانش یا مال)
senses.ep: او توانست در طول سفرهایش دانش خوبی از زبان اسپانیایی کسب کند.

senses.d: to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a new situation
senses.e: It is difficult to adapt a complex novel for a short film.
senses.p: تطبیق دادن، وفق دادن چیزی با شرایط جدید
senses.ep: تطبیق دادن یک رمان پیچیده برای یک فیلم کوتاه کار دشواری است.

senses.d: enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose
senses.e: The hotel room was small, but it was clean and adequate.
senses.ep: اتاق هتل کوچک بود، اما تمیز و کافی بود.

senses.d: to change something slightly to make it more correct, effective, or suitable
senses.e: You need to adjust the height of the chair so your back is comfortable.
senses.p: تنظیم کردن، تغییر دادن جزئی چیزی برای بهبود آن
senses.ep: باید ارتفاع صندلی را تنظیم کنید تا کمرتان راحت باشد.

senses.d: having a strong desire to be successful, rich, or powerful
senses.e: She is a very ambitious young lawyer who wants to become a partner.
senses.ep: او وکیل جوانی بسیار جاه‌طلبی است که می‌خواهد شریک مؤسسه شود.

senses.d: to expect something to happen and prepare for it beforehand
senses.e: We don't anticipate any major problems with the new system.
senses.p: پیش‌بینی کردن، انتظار چیزی را داشتن
senses.ep: ما هیچ مشکل بزرگی را با سیستم جدید پیش‌بینی نمی‌کنیم.

senses.d: feeling worried, nervous, or afraid about something uncertain
senses.e: Parents are naturally anxious about their children's safety online.
senses.ep: والدین به طور طبیعی نگران امنیت فرزندانشان در فضای مجازی هستند.

senses.d: easy to see or understand; clear
senses.e: It soon became apparent that she had lost interest in the project.
senses.ep: به زودی آشکار شد که او دیگر به پروژه علاقه ای ندارد.

senses.d: suitable or right for a particular situation or occasion
senses.e: Jeans are not appropriate attire for a formal dinner party.
senses.ep: شلوار جین لباس مناسبی برای یک مهمانی شام رسمی نیست.

senses.d: to make a judgment about the nature, quality, or value of something
senses.e: The teacher needs to assess the students' progress at the end of every term.
senses.ep: معلم باید پیشرفت دانش‌آموزان را در پایان هر ترم ارزیابی کند.

senses.d: to help someone or something to do something
senses.e: An experienced project manager will assist you with the new software.
senses.ep: یک مدیر پروژه باتجربه در کار با نرم‌افزار جدید به شما کمک خواهد کرد.

senses.d: to accept something to be true without having proof
senses.e: We cannot assume that everyone attending the meeting speaks English.
senses.ep: ما نمی‌توانیم فرض کنیم که همه افراد حاضر در جلسه انگلیسی صحبت می‌کنند.

senses.d: to try to do something, especially something difficult
senses.e: She decided to attempt the difficult exam despite having little preparation.
senses.ep: او تصمیم گرفت با وجود آمادگی کم، امتحان دشوار را امتحان کند.

senses.d: to make someone or something interested in coming closer or taking notice
senses.e: The vibrant colors of the flowers attract many butterflies to the garden.
senses.ep: رنگ‌های شاداب گل‌ها پروانه‌های زیادی را به باغ جذب می‌کند.

senses.d: able to be used or obtained; able to be reached or spoken to
senses.e: There are several cheaper options available for your trip to Europe.
senses.ep: چندین گزینه ارزان‌تر برای سفر شما به اروپا در دسترس است.

senses.d: knowing that something exists, or having knowledge or experience of a particular thing
senses.e: Are you aware of the new security regulations introduced this week?
senses.ep: آیا از مقررات امنیتی جدیدی که این هفته معرفی شده است آگاه هستید؟

senses.d: a heavy duty, responsibility, or worry that is difficult to bear
senses.e: Paying high taxes can become a heavy financial burden for small businesses.
senses.ep: پرداخت مالیات‌های سنگین می‌تواند به یک بار مالی سنگین برای کسب‌وکارهای کوچک تبدیل شود.

senses.d: a condition or fact that affects a particular situation or event
senses.e: We could not travel this summer because of unexpected family circumstances.
senses.ep: ما نتوانستیم تابستان امسال به خاطر شرایط پیش‌بینی‌نشده خانوادگی سفر کنیم.

senses.d: to make something clearer or easier to understand by explaining it more
senses.e: I asked the teacher to clarify the instructions for the assignment.
senses.ep: از معلم خواستم دستورالعمل‌های مربوط به تکلیف را روشن کند.

senses.d: to promise sincerely to do something or to use money, time, etc. for a particular purpose
senses.e: The government has committed more funds to improve public healthcare.
senses.ep: دولت بودجه بیشتری را برای بهبود بهداشت عمومی اختصاص داده است.

senses.d: to try to be more successful or better than others who are doing the same thing
senses.e: Several companies are competing for the major government contract.
senses.ep: چندین شرکت برای به‌دست آوردن قرارداد بزرگ دولتی با هم رقابت می‌کنند.

senses.d: to give all your attention to something and not think about anything else
senses.e: I cannot concentrate on my studies with all that noise outside.
senses.ep: با وجود آن همه سر و صدا در بیرون، نمی‌توانم روی درس‌هایم تمرکز کنم.

senses.d: a result of an action or situation, especially a bad or unpleasant result
senses.e: If you break the rules, you must face the consequences of your actions.
senses.ep: اگر قوانین را زیر پا بگذارید، باید با پیامدهای کارهای خود روبرو شوید.

senses.d: always behaving in the same way, or happening in the same way over time
senses.e: She has been our most consistent player throughout the entire season.
senses.ep: او در طول تمام فصل ثاب‌ت‌قدم‌ترین بازیکن ما بوده است.

senses.d: to give money, help, or ideas to something that other people are also helping
senses.e: Many local residents contributed money to rebuild the community center.
senses.ep: بسیاری از ساکنان محلی برای بازسازی مرکز جامعه پول کمک کردند.

senses.d: to make someone believe that something is true by using arguments or evidence
senses.e: He managed to convince the committee of the value of his research.
senses.ep: او توانست کمیته را از ارزش پژوهش خود متقاعد کند.

senses.d: to work together with someone else in order to achieve something
senses.e: Both countries agreed to cooperate in the fight against international crime.
senses.ep: هر دو کشور توافق کردند که در مبارزه با جرم و جنایت بین‌المللی با یکدیگر همکاری کنند.

senses.d: to express disapproval of someone or something, or to talk about their faults
senses.e: Local residents criticized the council for failing to fix the damaged roads.
senses.ep: مقیمان محلی شورا را به خاطر عدم تعمیر جاده‌های آسیب‌دیده مورد انتقاد قرار دادند.

senses.d: to decrease in quantity, quality, or strength; to become smaller or worse
senses.e: Property values have declined steadily over the past twelve months.
senses.ep: ارزش ملک در دوازده ماه گذشته به طور پیوسته کاهش یافته است.

senses.d: to show clearly how something works or how to do something
senses.e: The chef will demonstrate how to prepare fresh pasta during the workshop.
senses.ep: سرآشپز در طول کارگاه نشان خواهد داد که چگونه پاستای تازه تهیه کنید.

senses.d: to state that something is not true or that you have not done something
senses.e: The suspect strongly denied stealing the money from the corner shop.
senses.ep: مظنون به شدت سرقت پول از مغازه سر کوچه را انکار کرد.

senses.d: to discover the facts about something or calculate something exactly
senses.e: An inquiry was set up to determine the exact cause of the accident.
senses.ep: تحقیقی برای تعیین علت دقیق تصادف تشکیل شد.

senses.d: to make someone lose their confidence or enthusiasm for doing something
senses.e: Don't let initial failures discourage you from pursuing your career goals.
senses.ep: اجازه ندهید شکست‌های اولیه شما را از دنبال کردن اهداف شغلی‌تان دلسرد کنند.

senses.d: to share things among a group of people or hand them out
senses.e: Volunteers distributed warm blankets and food packages to the refugees.
senses.ep: داوطلبان پتوهای گرم و بسته‌های غذایی را بین پناهندگان توزیع کردند.

senses.d: including many different types of people or things; varied
senses.e: The university attracts students from a diverse range of cultural backgrounds.
senses.ep: این دانشگاه دانشجویانی را از طیف متنوعی از پیشینه‌های فرهنگی جذب می‌کند.

senses.d: to give special importance to something or show that it is particularly important
senses.e: The teacher emphasized the importance of regular reading for vocabulary growth.
senses.ep: معلم بر اهمیت مطالعه منظم برای رشد دایره واژگان تأکید کرد.

senses.d: to give someone the ability or opportunity to do something, or make something possible
senses.e: Advanced software can enable businesses to track inventory levels in real time.
senses.ep: نرم‌افزار پیشرفته می‌تواند کسب‌وکارها را قادر سازد تا سطح موجودی را به صورت لحظه‌ای پیگیری کنند.

senses.d: to meet someone or something, especially unexpectedly or by chance
senses.e: We encountered a lot of traffic on the way to the airport.
senses.ep: ما در راه به فرودگاه ترافیک زیادی داشتیم.

senses.d: to suffer something unpleasant patiently over a long period
senses.e: The team endured years of poor results before winning the cup.
senses.ep: تیم سال‌ها نتا��ج بد را تحمل کرد قبل از اینکه جام را ببرد.

senses.d: to involve yourself in an activity or conversation
senses.e: The students engaged in a lively debate about climate change.
senses.ep: دانش‌آموزان در یک بحث پرجنب‌وجوش درباره تغییرات اقلیمی درگیر شدند.

senses.d: to improve the quality, value, or extent of something
senses.e: The new lighting will enhance the atmosphere of the restaurant.
senses.ep: نورپردازی جدید جو رستوران را بهبود خواهد بخشید.

senses.d: to start a company, organization, or system and make it permanent
senses.e: The company was established in 1998 by two engineers.
senses.ep: شرکت در سال ۱۹۹۸ توسط دو مهندس تأسیس شد.

senses.d: to say how much, how many, or how big something is or will be, based on calculations
senses.e: Experts estimate that the project will cost two million dollars.
senses.ep: کارشناسان تخمین می‌زنند که این پروژه دو میلیون دلار هزینه خواهد داشت.

senses.d: to become larger or more extensive
senses.e: The company plans to expand into the Asian market next year.
senses.ep: شرکت برنامه دارد سال آینده به بازار آسیا گسترش یابد.

senses.d: to reveal something that was previously hidden or unknown
senses.e: The report exposed corruption within the government.
senses.ep: گزارش فساد در دولت را آشکار کرد.

senses.d: covering a large area or amount
senses.e: She has extensive experience in international marketing.
senses.ep: او تجربه گسترده‌ای در بازاریابی بین‌المللی دارد.

senses.d: a distinctive attribute or aspect of something
senses.e: One key feature of this phone is its long battery life.
senses.ep: یکی از ویژگی‌های کلیدی این تلفن عمر باتری طولانی آن است.

senses.d: able to change or be changed easily to suit new situations or conditions
senses.e: Our schedule is quite flexible, so we can easily change the meeting time.
senses.ep: برنامه ما کاملاً انعطاف‌پذیر است، بنابراین می‌توانیم به راحتی زمان جلسه را تغییر دهیم.

senses.d: to cause something to exist or happen, such as energy, profits, or ideas
senses.e: The new wind farm will generate enough electricity for thousands of homes.
senses.ep: مزرعه بادی جدید برق کافی برای هزاران خانه تولید خواهد کرد.

senses.d: to pause before saying or doing something because you are nervous or not sure
senses.e: Please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team if you need help.
senses.ep: اگر به کمک نیاز دارید، لطفاً در تماس با تیم خدمات مشتریان ما تردید نکنید.

senses.d: to recognize and correctly name someone or something
senses.e: The police asked the witness to identify the suspect from a photograph.
senses.ep: پلیس از شاهد خواست تا مظنون را از روی عکس شناسایی کند.

senses.d: to deliberately pay no attention to someone or something
senses.e: He chose to ignore the warning signs and continued driving in the storm.
senses.ep: او تصمیم گرفت علائم هشدار را نادیده بگیرد و به رانندگی در طوفان ادامه داد.

senses.d: to make a law, system, plan, etc. start to operate or happen
senses.e: The company decided to implement a new policy to reduce paper waste.
senses.ep: شرکت تصمیم گرفت سیاست جدیدی را برای کاهش زباله کاغذی اجرا کند.

senses.d: to suggest or state something indirectly, without saying it plainly
senses.e: Her tone of voice seemed to imply that she was not satisfied with the results.
senses.ep: لحن صدای او به نظر می‌رسید که نشان‌دهنده نارضایتی‌اش از نتایج است.

senses.d: to cause someone to feel admiration and respect
senses.e: Her deep knowledge of ancient history really impressed the interviewers.
senses.ep: دانش عمیق او از تاریخ باستان واقعاً مصاحبه‌کنندگان را تحت تأثیر قرار داد.

senses.d: to show, point, or make clear in another way
senses.e: Red traffic lights indicate that drivers must stop immediately.
senses.ep: چراغ‌های قرمز راهنمایی و رانندگی نشان می‌دهند که رانندگان باید بلافاصله متوقف شوند.

senses.d: to affect or change how someone behaves or thinks, or how something happens
senses.e: Good teachers can positively influence a student's future career choices.
senses.ep: معلمان خوب می‌توانند به طور مثبت بر انتخاب‌های شغلی آینده دانش‌آموز تأثیر بگذارند.

senses.d: to officially tell someone about something or give them information
senses.e: Please inform the manager of any changes to your schedule.
senses.ep: لطفاً مدیر را از هرگونه تغییر در برنامه خود مطلع کنید.

senses.d: the ability to make decisions and take action without waiting for someone to tell you what to do
senses.e: She showed great initiative by fixing the broken equipment herself.
senses.ep: او با تعمیر کردن تجهیزات خراب توسط خودش، ابتکار عمل زیادی نشان داد.

senses.d: to demand strongly that something must happen or that you must have something
senses.e: He will insist on paying for dinner whenever we meet.
senses.ep: او هر زمان که همدیگر را می‌بینیم اصرار می‌کند که پول شام را بدهد.

senses.d: to make someone want to do something, especially by giving them good ideas and a feeling of enthusiasm
senses.e: The inspiring teacher managed to motivate all the students in her class.
senses.ep: معلم الهام‌بخش توانست همه دانش‌آموزان کلاسش را ترغیب کند.

senses.d: to have a plan, purpose, or goal in your mind to do something
senses.e: We intend to visit our relatives in Canada this summer.
senses.ep: ما قصد داریم تابستان امسال به دیدن فامیل‌هایمان در کانادا برویم.

senses.d: having a very strong effect or felt with a very high degree
senses.e: The athletes underwent intense training before the championship match.
senses.ep: ورزشکاران قبل از مسابقه قهرمانی تمرینات شدیدی را پشت سر گذاشتند.

senses.d: to get involved in a situation where you are not wanted and where your help is not helpful
senses.e: I try not to interfere in other people's personal relationships.
senses.ep: من تلاش می‌کنم در روابط شخصی دیگران دخالت نکنم.

senses.d: to explain the meaning of something, or to understand it in a particular way
senses.e: It is difficult to interpret the results of this scientific experiment.
senses.ep: تفسیر کردن نتایج این آزمایش علمی دشوار است.

senses.d: if a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part of it
senses.e: His new job will involve a lot of traveling abroad.
senses.ep: شغل جدید او شامل سفرهای خارجی زیادی خواهد بود.

senses.d: to show or prove that a decision, action, or idea is right or reasonable
senses.e: How can you justify spending so much money on designer clothes?
senses.ep: چطور می‌توانید خرج کردن این همه پول روی لباس‌های مارک‌دار را توجیه کنید؟

senses.d: to attach a label or write information on something to identify it
senses.e: She carefully labeled each folder with the project name and date.
senses.ep: او با دقت روی هر پوشه را با نام پروژه و تاریخ برچسب زد.

senses.d: to start an activity, plan, or product, or make it available to the public
senses.e: The company plans to launch a new smartphone next month.
senses.ep: این شرکت قصد دارد ماه آینده یک گوشی هوشمند جدید را به بازار عرضه کند.

senses.d: to keep a building, machine, or road in good condition by checking and repairing it regularly
senses.e: It costs a lot of money to maintain a large historic house.
senses.ep: نگهداری از یک خانه تاریخی بزرگ هزینه زیادی دارد.

senses.d: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics
senses.e: The union leaders are currently negotiating a new pay deal with management.
senses.ep: رهبران اتحادیه در حال حاضر در حال مذاکره بر سر توافق حقوقی جدیدی با مدیریت هستند.

senses.d: to get something, especially by asking for it, buying it, or working for it
senses.e: You need to obtain permission from the council before building an extension.
senses.ep: شما باید قبل از ساختن الحاقیه، از شهرداری اجازه بگیرید.

senses.d: to happen, especially without being planned
senses.e: The accident occurred at a busy intersection during the rush hour.
senses.ep: این تصادف در یک تقاطع شلوغ در ساعات اوج ترافیک رخ داد.

senses.d: a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do
senses.e: Studying abroad gives you a great opportunity to experience a new culture.
senses.ep: تحصیل در خارج از کشور فرصت عالی برای تجربه یک فرهنگ جدید به شما می‌دهد.

senses.d: to successfully deal with or control a problem or feeling that makes it difficult for you to do something
senses.e: She managed to overcome her fear of public speaking and delivered a great presentation.
senses.ep: او توانست بر ترس خود از سخنرانی در جمع غلبه کند و ارائه عالی‌ای داشت.

senses.d: to make someone agree to do something by giving them good reasons
senses.e: I managed to persuade my parents to let me go on the school trip.
senses.ep: توانستم والدینم را قانع کنم که اجازه دهند به اردوی مدرسه بروم.

senses.d: possible, or likely to develop or happen in the future
senses.e: We need to identify potential problems before we start the project.
senses.ep: ما باید قبل از شروع پروژه، مشکلات بالقوه را شناسایی کنیم.

senses.d: clear and accurate; exact in every detail
senses.e: The instructions were very precise, so we had no problems.
senses.ep: دستورالعمل‌ها بسیار دقیق بودند، پس هیچ مشکلی نداشتیم.

senses.d: With infinitive object: to be so presumptuous as to do something without proper authority or permission
senses.e: I wouldn't presume to tell him how to do his job
senses.ep: من به خودم جرات نمی‌دهم (یا به خودم اجازه نمی‌دهم) که به او بگویم چطور کارش را انجام دهد.

senses.d: An item's relative importance
senses.e: He set his e-mail message's priority to high
senses.ep: او اولویت پیام ایمیل خود را روی حالت «بالا» تنظیم کرد.

senses.d: To move, pass, or go forward or onward; to advance; to carry on
senses.e: To proceed on a journey
senses.ep: ادامه دادن به یک سفر

senses.d: A series of events which produce a result the product
senses.e: This product of last month's quality standards committee is quite good, even though the process was flawed
senses.ep: این محصولِ کمیته استانداردهای کیفیت ماه گذشته بسیار خوب است، هرچند که فرایند آن نقص داشت.

senses.d: able to be trusted to do what you expect or to work well
senses.e: She is a very reliable colleague and never misses a deadline.
senses.ep: او همکار بسیار قابل‌اعتمادی است و هرگز ضرب‌الاجل را از دست نمی‌دهد.

senses.d: Not wanting to take some action; unwilling
senses.e: She was reluctant to lend him the money
senses.ep: او بی‌میل بود که پول را به او قرض بدهد.

senses.d: a successful way of curing an illness or dealing with a problem
senses.e: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
senses.ep: راه‌حل ساده‌ای برای بیکاری وجود ندارد.

senses.d: to need something; to make it necessary
senses.e: This course requires a lot of reading.
senses.ep: این درس مستلزم مطالعه فراوانی است.

senses.d: To reduce to simple or intelligible notions; to make clear or certain; to unravel; to explain
senses.e: to resolve a riddle
senses.ep: حل کردن یک معما

senses.d: To say something in return; to answer; to reply
senses.e: to respond to a question or an argument
senses.ep: پاسخ دادن به یک سوال یا استدلال

senses.d: to put a limit on someone or something so that they cannot grow or change
senses.e: The new rules restrict parking in the downtown area during the day.
senses.ep: قوانین جدید پارک کردن در منطقه مرکزی شهر را در طول روز محدود می‌کند.

senses.d: to make something known that was previously secret or unknown
senses.e: The company refused to reveal the details of the new contract.
senses.ep: شرکت از فاش کردن جزئیات قرارداد جدید خودداری کرد.

senses.d: large or important enough to have an effect or to be noticed
senses.e: There has been a significant increase in the number of tourists this year.
senses.ep: امسال افزایشی قابل توجه در تعداد گردشگران رخ داده است.

senses.d: a planned series of actions for achieving something, especially over a long period
senses.e: The company developed a new sales strategy to attract younger customers.
senses.ep: شرکت یک راهبرد فروش جدید برای جذب مشتریان جوان‌تر تدوین کرد.

senses.d: continuing for a limited period of time, not permanent
senses.e: She found a temporary job working at a bookstore for the summer.
senses.ep: او یک کار موقت برای تابستان در یک کتابفروشی پیدا کرد.

senses.d: worth a lot of money, or very useful and helpful
senses.e: My grandfather gave me some valuable advice about starting a business.
senses.ep: پدربزرگم توصیه‌های ارزشمندی درباره راه‌اندازی کسب‌وکار به من داد.

senses.d: to offer to do something without being forced or paid to do it
senses.e: She volunteered to help organize the charity event this weekend.
senses.ep: او داوطلب شد تا در سازماندهی رویداد خیریه این آخر هفته کمک کند.

senses.d: to take back something you said or agreed to do
senses.e: The candidate had to withdraw his controversial statement after public criticism.
senses.ep: نامزد مجبور شد پس از انتقادهای عمومی، اظهارنظر جنجالی خود را پس بگیرد.

senses.d: someone who sees a crime or an accident happen
senses.e: Police are appealing for any witnesses to come forward with information.
senses.ep: پلیس از هر شاهدی درخواست می‌کند که اطلاعات خود را ارائه دهد.
